name: 女童翻领呢大衣气质款
description: 玫瑰色系女童呢子大衣套图：翻领版型、呢料细节与尺码信任一次讲清

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and variant rows, misty blush #F7ECF2 for info and closing shots, pale blue-grey #EDF1F7 and warm beige #E9DFD3 reserved for scene and silhouette panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; scene shots use 5200-5500K ambient daylight
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio sweep, soft painted wall panels and smooth rose satin lining as the only reflective surface
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color, empty tile style for care and spec rows
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for worn shots and straight-on eye-level for display rows; garment always shown full length or as declared detail crop
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet-premium children outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, misty blush #F7ECF2, charcoal text #33383D and one rose accent #D6336C; warm soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end children fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示大衣完整廓形
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front view at eye-level, coat displayed on a child-size tailoring form, full garment visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A children wool coat displayed on a child-size tailoring form, photographed from a slight 3/4 front view at eye-level, full garment visible from collar to hem with sleeves relaxed. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the form. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. No extra whitespace. 8K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no child model or face, no props, no hangers, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off sleeves or hem, no colored background tint.

shots.intent: 一秒传达翻领穿搭的利落气质，承接首图进入卖点
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, worn by a generic child model framed from the neck down
shots.lighting: warm soft key light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow
shots.background: misty blush #F7ECF2 with a soft interior feel
shots.props: a slim plain bead necklace on the model, no brand marks
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 35% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The coat worn by a generic child model framed strictly from the neck down, photographed straight-on at eye-level, one small hand lightly touching the wide fold-down lapel to lead the eye. Warm soft key light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow. Background misty blush #F7ECF2. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Generous negative space on the left 35% for copy, headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in #33383D. Negative: no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no more than one claim, no invented fabric percentages, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the coat.

shots.intent: 放大薄外套挡不住风的冬季穿衣痛点，引出厚呢大衣
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, both panels photographed straight-on at eye-level
shots.lighting: left panel flat and chilly, right panel warm and soft
shots.props: a thin flimsy children jacket on the left panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level framing. Left panel: a thin flimsy children jacket on a child-size form, hem lifting in a gust of cold wind, rendered under flat chilly light on cool grey #ECEFF4. Right panel: {product} on an identical form in warm soft light, hem hanging smooth and heavy. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment occupies 40-50% per panel. No extra whitespace. Negative: no child model or face, no fabricated statistics or temperature numbers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched framing between panels, no messy clutter.

shots.lighting: late-afternoon ambient daylight, 5200K, long soft shadows

shots.intent: 并列展示多色多图案版本，让买家按喜好选色

shots.lighting: identical even high-key light across all three units, soft contact shadows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：p1 玫红翻领呢大衣童模正身照（大写字标占位与欧美简约风文案横幅）；p2 多色排列（粉/红/格纹）与翻领圆形细节；p3 背面45度版型展示与H型直身版型文案；p4 口袋与下摆圆形细节、面料特写横幅（含羊毛含量百分比与亲肤吸湿类宣称）、亲肤柔软吸湿图标；p5 产品信息（颜色玫红、尺码110-160身高段、模特身高110cm体重20kg）与长度柔软版型厚度弹力五组滑杆、肩宽衣长袖长胸围尺码表；p6 洗涤说明图标、年龄体重身高对照表、色差说明与模特全身展示；p7 门襟口袋细节与童模近景、外文装饰贴片；p8 童模正面展示；p9 正背面展示与平铺正侧面；p10 领子与按扣微距；p11 袖口口袋里料微距；p12 里料绸缎与呢料表面微距。品类判定：尺码为110-160身高段、附3-14岁年龄体重对照表、模特身高110cm体重20kg、成衣为外穿呢子大衣而非贴身内衣或家居服，判定为母婴/童装（外穿外套），与源夹名一致。已剥离：原品牌字标与LOGO占位字样、童模面容与身份（套图一律以颈部以下裁切、背影或无头裁缝台形式呈现的generic child model替代）、原文案原句与外文装饰贴片、羊毛含量百分比等成分与功效数值、洗护与年龄对照表具体数值（一律改为空白占位）、促销按钮与卡通贴纸，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
